slides.label: Slide 1
lines: Lord, You’re our dearest shepherd
And so we shall not want
Lord, You’re the strength of our lives
Of whom shall we be afraid?
You gave us a Kingdom
That cannot be moved
We Your saints, thank You, Lord
For the conquests in Your name

slides.label: Slide 3
lines: Lord God, You are with us
We will not be dismayed
Lord Jesus, we are the fruits
And splendor of Your deeds

slides.label: Slide 4
lines: Master, You kept Your word
Just as You said, You would
All that we would desire
You willed it all to us

slides.label: Slide 6
lines: We’re not afraid of what’s before us

slides.label: Slide 9
